The hospital staffing resilience integration achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing all legacy node checks in the test suite.
The execution finished with a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite confirmed success via 'test_output.py::test_legacy_node_checks', which passed in 0.15 seconds. While the integration is reusable, future iterations should re-check the discrepancy between the perfect verifier score and the lower judge reward to identify potential qualitative gaps.
